reference: No matching at CLI is assumed. Documented private-spool queue contracts use independently specified script bytes, fixed epochs and Python filesystem checks. No scheduler daemon or queued command is executed.
coverage: Bash reports the loadable as a builtin through `type -t`.
The Bash help builtin exposes the documented at synopsis, options, and accepted time forms.
Operation coverage: fixed-epoch script publication and modes, repeated input/unique names, seeded list/print/remove, time and arity rejection.
All nine documented clock-dependent UTC forms checked with independent Python calendar/epoch arithmetic inside a bounded observation window.
exclusions: Daemon execution and live system queues are outside this suite. Every at invocation sets a relative BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR.
Bash type/help and command help/version cases are metadata only and do not count as operation coverage.

Clock-dependent forms are checked within a measured UTC time window; forced exact-second transitions and non-UTC DST behavior are not qualified. No GNU at CLI parity is claimed for the custom spool format.

cases.purpose: Check Bash builtin discovery without invoking the scheduler operation.
Check that Bash help presents the documented synopsis, queue controls, and supported time forms.
cases.script:
h=$(help at)
[[ $h == *'Schedule one-shot jobs (small POSIX at subset).'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'at TIME      read commands from stdin and queue them'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'at -l        list queued job ids'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'at -r JOBID  remove a queued job'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'at -c JOBID  print a queued job script'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'TIME accepts now, noon, midnight, teatime, @EPOCH, EPOCH,'* ]] || exit 1
[[ $h == *'+N[s|m|h|d], or HH:MM.'* ]] || exit 1
printf 'documented at help verified\n'

cases.purpose: Queue one fixed-epoch inert script in a private spool; verify exact newline/header bytes, 0600 job mode, 0700 directories and absence of partial files without executing the script.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
printf 'fixture text' > input
at @4102444800 < input > receipt
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,stat
m=re.fullmatch(r'job ([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+) scheduled for 4102444800\n',Path('receipt').read_text()); assert m
p=Path('spool/atjobs')/(m[1]+'.job')
assert p.read_bytes()==b'# run_at=4102444800\nfixture text\n'
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600
assert set(Path('spool/atjobs').iterdir())=={p}
for d in ['spool','spool/atjobs']: assert stat.S_IMODE(Path(d).stat().st_mode)==0o700
print('published bytes and modes verified')
PY

cases.purpose: List only the seeded job ID and print its body without the private scheduling header.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
mkdir -p spool/atjobs
printf '# run_at=4102444800\nseeded bytes\n' > spool/atjobs/alpha.job
printf 'not a job\n' > spool/atjobs/ignored.txt
at -l
at -c alpha

cases.purpose: Remove one seeded job, preserve a second entry, and report a missing-job error; only private files are changed.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
mkdir -p spool/atjobs
printf '# run_at=4102444800\nseeded bytes\n' > spool/atjobs/alpha.job
printf 'not a job\n' > spool/atjobs/ignored.txt
printf '# run_at=4102444800\nkeep\n' > spool/atjobs/beta.job
at -r alpha
[[ ! -e spool/atjobs/alpha.job && -e spool/atjobs/beta.job ]]
at -l
at -c beta
at -r absent

cases.purpose: Invalid time spelling, missing job ID and extra list operands return usage failure without publishing any job.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
for scenario in time cat list; do
 rc=0
 case $scenario in
 time) at not-a-time || rc=$? ;;
 cat) at -c || rc=$? ;;
 list) at -l extra || rc=$? ;;
 esac
 [[ $rc == 2 ]]
 printf '%s=%s\n' "$scenario" "$rc"
done
[[ ! -e spool ]]

cases.purpose: Queue two distinct redirected inputs and empty stdin in the same shell at one fixed epoch; assert unique jobs and exact complete payloads without running any job.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
printf first > first
printf 'second\n' > second
: > empty
at 4102444800 < first > first-receipt
at 4102444800 < second > second-receipt
at 4102444800 < empty > empty-receipt
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=list(Path('spool/atjobs').iterdir()); assert len(p)==3
assert all(x.suffix=='.job' for x in p)
assert {x.read_bytes() for x in p}=={b'# run_at=4102444800\nfirst\n',b'# run_at=4102444800\nsecond\n',b'# run_at=4102444800\n\n'}
print('three unique complete scripts')
PY

cases.purpose: Queue all documented UTC clock-dependent time forms without executing their inert payloads. An independent Python calendar oracle checks each epoch within the measured before/after window, including next-day rollover.
cases.script:
export BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=spool
printf 'inert fixture text' > input
printf '%(%s)T\n' -1 > before
index=0
for when in now noon midnight teatime +2s +2m +2h +2d 12:34; do
 at "$when" < input > "receipt-$index"
 printf '%s\n' "$when" > "time-$index"
 index=$((index+1))
done
printf '%(%s)T\n' -1 > after
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import re
start=int(Path('before').read_text()); end=int(Path('after').read_text())
assert 0<=end-start<=15
names=[]
def epoch_for(t,form):
    if form=='now': return t
    if form.startswith('+'): return t+2*{'s':1,'m':60,'h':3600,'d':86400}[form[-1]]
    h,m={'noon':(12,0),'midnight':(0,0),'teatime':(16,0),'12:34':(12,34)}[form]
    at=datetime.fromtimestamp(t,timezone.utc).replace(hour=h,minute=m,second=0,microsecond=0)
    if at.timestamp()<t: at+=timedelta(days=1)
    return int(at.timestamp())
for i in range(9):
    form=Path('time-'+str(i)).read_text().strip()
    m=re.fullmatch(r'job ([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+) scheduled for ([0-9]+)\n',Path('receipt-'+str(i)).read_text()); assert m
    actual=int(m[2]); assert actual in {epoch_for(t,form) for t in range(start,end+1)},(form,actual)
    job=Path('spool/atjobs')/(m[1]+'.job');names.append(job)
    assert job.read_bytes()==('# run_at='+str(actual)+'\ninert fixture text\n').encode()
assert len(set(names))==9 and set(Path('spool/atjobs').iterdir())==set(names)
print('nine UTC time forms and complete payloads verified')
PY
cases.stdout: nine UTC time forms and complete payloads verified
